meta.newDescription: Describe your idea for a social innovation: we will check whether something similar already works and help you develop it.
meta.canvasDescription: Work through your idea on the three sheets of the INNO AGH Social Innovation Canvas and print it.

new.title: I have an idea
new.lead: Describe your idea for a social innovation in four steps. We will check whether something similar already works in Małopolska, and the assistant will help you develop it. Your idea goes to the ROPS team as a case with a code.

errors.generic: This could not be sent. Please check the form and try again.

access.notIdea: This case is not an idea — the canvas and the application are only for ideas.
access.wrongToken: This private link is not valid. Open the case with its code alone, or with the link you were given.

notFound.title: We can’t open this idea
notFound.badCode: This doesn’t look like a case code. A code looks like JD-XXXX-XXXX.
notFound.missing: We couldn’t find a case with this code. Please check the code and try again.

whatHappens.heading: What happens to your idea
whatHappens.step1: The ROPS team gets a notification (the bell and an email).
whatHappens.step2: The AI assistant sorts your submission, and a person reads it and replies.
whatHappens.step3: You will see the reply under your idea’s code, and we will also send it the way you chose.

wizard.heading: Idea card
wizard.restored: We restored a draft saved on this device.
wizard.autosave: Your draft is saved automatically on this device — without your contact details. You don’t need an account.

what.title: What is your idea?
what.description: Use your own words. It doesn’t have to be perfect — you can change it later.
what.name: Name of your idea
what.nameHint: Keep it short, for example „Shared shopping for older people in our village”.
what.textHint: What do you want to do? How will it work? What problem does it solve?

who.title: Who does it help?
who.description: Describe the people your idea is meant to help, and choose the areas of the Mapa Wyzwań Społecznych (Social Challenges Map).
who.targetHint: For example „older people living alone in small villages who rarely leave home”.
who.areas: Areas of the Mapa Wyzwań Społecznych
who.areasHint: Tick one or more. The AI assistant can suggest which ones fit.

where.title: Where, and who is sending it?
where.description: Last step. Your contact details and municipality are optional — you can also see the reply with your case code.
where.gmina: The municipality where you want to act

errors.title: Please give your idea a name — at least 3 characters.
errors.description: Please describe your idea in at least two sentences.
errors.targetGroup: Please write who your idea should help.
errors.stage: Please choose a stage — it helps us find the right support.
errors.gmina: Choose a municipality in the county you picked, or „— I’d rather not say —”.
errors.goBackWhat: Go back to step 1 and fill in the name and description of your idea.
errors.goBackWho: Go back to step 2 and write who your idea should help.
errors.goBackStage: Go back to step 3 and choose the stage of your idea.

intro.heading: What to expect
intro.step2: Who it helps — here we check whether something similar already exists and switch on the AI assistant
intro.step4: Where, and who is sending it
intro.after: Then you get a case code, and ROPS usually replies within 2 working days.
intro.blankCanvas: Prefer to think it through on paper first? Print a blank innovation canvas

similarAfter.heading: Similar solutions already exist
similarAfter.body: The ROPS team will see them next to your idea. Maybe it’s worth getting in touch with their authors?

next.heading: What next?
next.canvas: Work through your idea on the innovation canvas
next.canvasHint: Three INNO AGH sheets: the problem, the people, costs, partners and impact.
next.applicationHint: The call’s form fields, filled in from your idea card.

similar.heading: Does this already exist?
similar.idle: Once you describe your idea, we’ll compare it with the Biblioteka Innowacji Społecznych (Social Innovation Library).
similar.error: We couldn’t check the library just now. You can carry on.
similar.found: {count, plural, =0 {We found no similar solution in the library.} one {We found 1 similar solution.} other {We found # similar solutions.}}
similar.noneHint: That’s a good sign for a new idea.
similar.joinAuthors: Maybe you could join their authors instead of starting from scratch?

assistant.heading: AI assistant
assistant.intro: It asks questions that help you develop your idea, suggests unusual variations, gives a first assessment against the call’s criteria and draws a sketch. You don’t have to use it.
assistant.thinking: The assistant is thinking… (up to 30 seconds)
assistant.needDescription: First describe your idea in step 1 (at least two sentences).
assistant.unavailable: The AI assistant is temporarily unavailable
assistant.continueWithout: You can finish without it — the ROPS team will read your idea.
assistant.stale: You have changed your idea card since the last suggestions. Select „Ask again” so the assessment matches the current version.
assistant.areas: Fits these areas of the Social Challenges Map
assistant.aiNote: These suggestions were prepared by artificial intelligence from your idea card. Please check them — they may be wrong.

sketch.heading: Sketch of your idea
sketch.intro: The assistant draws a simple diagram of your idea — for example an invention, a place or how a service works. It helps when you show your idea to others.
sketch.draw: Draw a sketch of my idea
sketch.unavailable: The AI assistant is temporarily unavailable, so we can’t draw a sketch right now. You can finish without it.
sketch.failed: We couldn’t draw the sketch. Please try again in a moment.
sketch.disclaimer: Sketch prepared automatically — for illustration only.

selfScore.heading: First self-assessment (not a ROPS assessment)
selfScore.intro: Merit criteria: each is scored from 0 to 10 points.
selfScore.introCall: Merit criteria of the call „{name}”: each is scored from 0 to 10 points.
selfScore.minimum: Minimum for this criterion: {min} pts — {met, select, yes {met} other {not met}}.
selfScore.meets: Looks like it meets the minimum.
selfScore.below: Looks below the minimum — see what to improve.
selfScore.manual: Assess it yourself: criteria of the call „{name}”
selfScore.manualMinimum: Minimum in total: {min} out of {total} pts.

canvas.unavailable: The canvas is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
canvas.partnerStatus: Next to each partner, add their status:
canvas.notesHint: Add in your own words anything the options above don’t cover.
canvas.restored: We restored unsaved changes from this device. Select „Save canvas” to save them to your case.
canvas.restoredReadOnly: We restored unsaved changes from this device.
canvas.notSaved: Not saved: {error} Your changes are still on this device.
canvas.unsaved: You have unsaved changes (they are safe on this device).

readOnly.title: You opened this canvas with the case code alone
readOnly.body: You can fill it in and print it, and your changes stay on this device. Only the person who sent the idea can save them to the case — open the canvas from the private link you got when you sent your idea.

canvas.source: Social Innovation Canvas — INNO AGH, version {version} of {date}, based on the Social Innovation Canvas by The New Global School

canvasPage.title: Social innovation canvas
canvasPage.lead: Idea „{title}” (case {code}). Three sheets help you think through the problem, the people, costs, partners and impact.
canvasPage.prefilled: We filled in some fields from your idea card — please check them.

blank.title: Blank social innovation canvas
blank.lead: The three Social Innovation Canvas sheets, with questions that help you think through the problem, the people, costs, partners and impact. Print them and fill them in on paper — on your own or with a team. You don’t need to send anything.

applicationPage.title: Application draft
applicationPage.lead: Idea „{title}” (case {code}). We’ll prepare a draft grant application from what you have already written — you fill in the rest.
applicationPage.canvasFirst: Fill in the canvas first (better draft)

noCall.title: No call is open right now
noCall.body: The application draft only works while a call for applications is open. Sign up for notifications — we’ll let you know when ROPS announces a new one.

polishOnly.title: Applications to ROPS are submitted in Polish
polishOnly.body: You can prepare your draft here in English to think it through, but the call’s own application form must be filled in in Polish. Switch the site to Polish and the assistant will write the draft in Polish.

pick.heading: Choose a call
pick.body: {count, plural, one {# call is open} other {# calls are open}} that you can prepare an application for. Each has its own form and assessment criteria — we’ll tailor the draft to the one you choose.
pick.legend: The call you are writing for

window.none: The call announcement gives the dates.

who.iws: individuals, organisations, public institutions and informal groups
who.uslugaWrazliwa: social welfare and social services centres (OPS, CUS), county family support centres (PCPR) and NGOs in Małopolska

demoNote.iws: This is a demonstration call for the prototype. We copied its form fields and assessment criteria from the „Inkubator Włączenia Społecznego 2.0” call (ROPS Kraków, FERS, Measure 5.1).
demoNote.uslugaWrazliwa: This is a demonstration call for the prototype, modelled on the „Usługa Wrażliwa” project (ROPS Kraków). Its form fields follow the sections of an implementation plan („Ramowy Plan Wdrożenia”), and its assessment criteria are samples. It is not a call announced by ROPS.
demoNote.other: This is a demonstration call for the prototype.

gen.heading: Application draft
gen.body: We’ll fill in the form fields from your idea card and canvas. Anything that isn’t there — amounts, dates, partners — we don’t make up: in those places you’ll see „{gap}”.
gen.empty: I’ll fill it in myself from scratch
gen.wait: Writing the draft — this can take up to a minute.

failed.heading: The draft isn’t ready
failed.body: The AI assistant stopped writing, so we haven’t put anything into the form. Try again, or prepare a draft without AI — from your idea card and canvas.

edit.heading: Check and edit your application
edit.restored: We restored a draft saved on this device.
edit.sentBefore: You sent this application on {date}. You can edit it and send it again.
edit.templateTitle: The AI assistant is temporarily unavailable
edit.templateBody: We prepared a template from your idea card and canvas. Fill in the fields marked „{gap}”.
edit.aiNote: This draft was written by artificial intelligence from your information. Read it carefully before you send it.
edit.gapsNone: Draft ready. All fields are filled in — read them through once more before you send.
edit.gaps: Draft ready. Gaps marked „{gap}” remain in {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} — fill them in before you send.
edit.flaggedTitle: To check: numbers that are not in your idea card
edit.flaggedBody: {numbers} — check where they came from, and correct or remove them before you send.
edit.notTheCall: Sending passes the draft to the ROPS team in your case. It does not submit an application to the call — you submit that in the call’s online form.

redo.question: A new draft will replace everything that is in the fields now — including your edits. Prepare it again?

readOnly.title: You opened the application with the case code alone
readOnly.body: You can prepare and edit the draft, but only the person who sent the idea can send it to ROPS — open this page from the private link you got when you sent your idea.

sent.heading: Application sent to ROPS
sent.body: The application is in the thread of case {code}.
sent.gaps: {count, plural, one {# field still needs filling in} other {# fields still need filling in}} — the ROPS team will help you finish.

template.areas: Areas of the Social Challenges Map: {areas}.

missing.title: name of the innovation
missing.problemDiagnosis: statistics and the sources of the diagnosis
missing.change: how the innovation will change the situation of the people it is for
missing.futureVision: whether it can be used on a larger scale and in other places
missing.actionPlan: activities, dates and costs: preparation of up to 3 months, two test phases of up to 9 months in total
missing.grantAmount: grant amount in PLN — the sum of the costs in the action plan
missing.team: who runs the project and what experience they have
missing.serviceGoal: aim of the service: what problem it solves and what changes for the people who use it
missing.targetGroup: how many people the service will support, and how you know
missing.scope: kinds of support, where and how often the service runs
missing.schedule: stages with approximate months: preparation, launch, running the service, review
missing.staff: who provides the service, their qualifications, how many posts or hours
missing.partners: partners and the role of each
missing.budget: main costs and an estimate in PLN — to be checked by ROPS
missing.risks: risks and how you will prevent them
missing.indicators: indicators and how you will measure them
missing.innovation: name of the innovation from the Biblioteka Innowacji Społecznych and why you chose it
